author: SnowSX3
body:
Hello.
I got promoted to Jr.Moderator today and I feel like a thank you is in order.

The amount of support I have received in the weeks leading up to the staff applications was insane.
I never knew how many people thought that I was good enough to become a moderator.
It just blew me away.

Everyone from both the community and the staff believed in me and backed me even before these staff apps were announced, it was astonishing.

So now that I'm a Jr.Moderator, I wanted to say thank you. Thank you for the support and the positive encouragement you all have given me and thank you all for believing in me.

Now, it's my turn to give back.
I am going to be as active as I possibly can be, helping people and answering reports.

So thank you Avicus. 
I will not let you down.
